product.title: Full-Day Rainbow Mountain Adventure with ATV

description.text: In Cusco, this small-group Rainbow Mountain day uses an ATV from Japura so the group can reach Vinicunca Mountain without the long uphill hike. Breakfast and lunch are included; a listed destination fee and optional motorcycle rental appear separately from the From price. The published cap is about 12, and the calendar day runs about 12 to 13 hours including road time. The format suits visitors who want a guided off-road window on the colored slopes without renting machines independently or joining the walking trek. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cusco, and the itinerary stays on Japura and Vinicunca Mountain that define this ATV outing rather than a Moray-and-Maras quad circuit or a Palcoyo hike from the city.
